method: Built-in image_gen tool; original generated textile, subsequently mapped onto actual 3D costume UVs
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square PBR BASE COLOR texture for a Blender fantasy male ceremonial robe, NOT a character image. Generate only a perfectly flat orthographic fabric swatch filling the entire square edge to edge. Original luxury crimson silk brocade with extremely intricate fine antique-gold embroidered acanthus flame tendrils, tiny curling fern shoots, elegant narrow leaves, tiny dark garnet accents, interwoven thin golden threads. Dense sophisticated couture textile detailing with fine dark-red silk threads visible between the embroidery. Rich deep vermilion/crimson background, muted warm champagne gold and antique gold embroidery, never purple. Seamless repeating pattern, same pattern scale everywhere, balanced small interlocking motifs, no single central large medallion. Visually about 6 repeats across the image. Flat diffuse albedo under perfectly even illumination; NO directional light, NO shadows, NO specular highlights, NO folds, NO wrinkles, NO perspective, NO cloth edges. Not a photo of a folded fabric. No humans, no clothes silhouette, no typography, no logo, no borders, no watermark. This original bitmap will be mapped onto real 3D modeled clothing.
limitations: Albedo image only. Metallic mask and bump are derived in Blender from green channel; not measured PBR scans. Seamless repeat requested, not a mathematical guarantee.
